meta.features: Features: embedding, sender role (one-hot), is_vip, has_task, deadline proximity (0 if none or ambiguous, 1 if due now, 0 at one week), similarity to the promotions description, register.
meta.guardrails: After the model: a VIP sender with a TASK is at least P4; promotions are capped at P2; a manual override wins. Calendar data is not a feature, so it never lowers priority. Without the model file the service uses the deterministic rules (app/ml/priority_rules.py).
